name: Melding of Influences
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Here is some encased ooze created from the Felwood samples you recovered. Take the case to Un'Goro Crater and find a pure ooze... the primal variety will do nicely. When you get close enough, release the ooze in the case, and let us see what the two think of one another.

After the experiment concludes, bring me a sample of whatever is left over. I will await you here in the Apothecarium.
narrative.objectives: Bring a Merged Ooze Sample to Chemist Fuely in Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Oh, most excellent, adventurer. This is most excellent.

Such a tale. Who would have thought the two would interact with one another in such a way... I will have to spend more time looking at the environmental issues that cause changes in these creatures.

I will continue my research for now. Perhaps we will speak again soon. Until then, I wish you well.
narrative.requestItemsText: How goes the experiment, adventurer? I will continue to study the samples you've recovered for me--I am starting to see why Lady Sylvanas is so interested in these creatures. If they are truly part of the Old Gods, then who knows how it can be used to our benefit.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 52 to 56, 17,950 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Gather Un'Goro Slime Samples from any of the slimes in Un'Goro Crater.
